page.title: Settings
page.noSettingsHint: Baseline setting keys were not found. Retry the load or restore product defaults.

documentHeader.removeLogoConfirmBody: The logo no longer appears in the header of printed documents (work orders, purchase orders…). You can upload another one.
documentHeader.title: Documents & Branding
documentHeader.description: Configure the default letterhead injected at the top of printed work orders, intervention requests, and purchase orders.
documentHeader.logoHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF. Max 5 MB. Stored for document headers and future app chrome.
documentHeader.previewEmpty: No letterhead configured. Printed documents will omit a company header until you save content here.
documentHeader.invalidShape: Stored header value is invalid. Resetting to an empty template.

auditLog.loadError: The change log could not be loaded.

policy.governedDescription: This setting uses the Draft → Test → Activate workflow.
policy.noDraft: No draft exists. Click "Edit Draft" to create one.
policy.stepUpRequired: Step-up authentication required to activate this policy
policy.discardConfirmDescription: This will permanently delete the current draft. This action cannot be undone.
policy.loadError: The policy could not be loaded.
policy.unreadable: The stored policy is unreadable: it cannot be edited here. Contact support.

permissionDenied: You do not have permission to access settings

tabs.profileHint: Account details, password, PIN, trusted devices, and session history.
tabs.notificationsHint: Inbox, acknowledgements, snoozes, and per-category preferences.
tabs.generalHint: Language, currency and fiscal year, work orders, reliability, printed document header. Each setting shows its shipped value, who may change it and its history.
tabs.securityHint: Password policy, session policy, activity feed, and audit log.
tabs.integrationsHint: Sync status, license, connections, and diagnostics.

backupOps.title: Backup operations
backupOps.description: Back up, validate or restore the database, and review recent runs. Scheduled backups follow the backup policy and are kept in the application's backups folder.
backupOps.resetDescription: Erases all data on this device and restarts into first-time setup. A final backup is saved to the backups folder first. Data not yet synchronized to the server exists only in that backup.
backupOps.resetPhraseLabel: Type “ERASE ALL DATA” (or “EFFACER TOUTES LES DONNÉES”) to confirm
backupOps.restoreConfirmBody: All data entered since this backup was made will be replaced. The current database is saved first as a safety backup, then the application restarts.

integrations.profilesDescription: Read-only list of configured integration profiles.

dbEncryption.title: Database encryption
dbEncryption.description: Local data is encrypted (AES-256). The key is kept in the Windows credential store. Keep the recovery key offline: without it the database cannot be reopened if that key is lost.
dbEncryption.warning: Anyone with this key can read a copy of the database. Do not store it on this computer.
dbEncryption.revealError: Could not display the recovery key

catalog.restoredSummary: Setting '{{key}}' restored to its shipped value
catalog.whoMayChange: Can be changed by the roles: {{roles}} (permission adm.settings)
catalog.nobodyMayChange: No active role holds the adm.settings permission.

locked.locale.fiscal_year_start_month: Locked: budget actuals, closed periods or postings are already stored by fiscal period. Changing the start month would move the whole past.
locked.locale.currency_code: Locked: stock, receipts or postings are already valued in this currency. Changing it would relabel every stored amount.

help.locale.primary_language: Default interface language for every user.
help.locale.fallback_language: Language used when a text is missing in the primary language.
help.locale.currency_code: Currency in which stock, purchases and costs are valued (ISO 4217 code).
help.locale.fiscal_year_start_month: First month of the fiscal year: budget periods, postings, period close.
help.wo.reopen_window_days: Days after closure during which a closed work order can be reopened (0 = never).
help.ram.fmeca_rpn_critical_threshold: From this risk priority number (S × O × D) an FMECA failure mode is critical.
help.backup.retention_daily: Number of daily scheduled backups kept (at least one).
help.backup.retention_weekly: Number of weekly backups kept in addition.
help.backup.retention_monthly: Number of monthly backups kept in addition.

catalog.historyLoadError: The history of this setting could not be loaded.

highRisk.title: Change "{{setting}}"?
highRisk.body: From {{from}} to {{to}}. This change is recorded with your name, the time and your reason, and asks you to confirm your identity.
highRisk.reasonHint: At least {{min}} characters; kept in the setting history.

license.title: Licence
license.loadError: The licence state could not be loaded
license.reasonHint: At least {{min}} characters. Kept in the licence audit trail.

advice.policySync: Policy synchronisation is pending: refresh the policy before making changes.
advice.revoked: The licence is revoked. Ask your administrator to reactivate it, then refresh the policy.
advice.suspended: The licence is suspended: the application is read-only until it is reactivated.
advice.activationDenied: Product activation was refused. Activate again or contact support.
advice.activationDegraded: Activation is degraded: the licence server cannot be reached. Refresh when online.
advice.activationPending: Product activation is awaiting online validation.
advice.machinePendingRevocation: This device's activation will be revoked at the next connection.
advice.machineRevoked: This device's activation is revoked. Ask your administrator to re-activate it.
advice.untrusted: This device is not trusted yet. Complete the online first start on a trusted device.
advice.healthy: The licence is in order: every operation is allowed.
advice.activationIncomplete: Activation is not complete. Finish activating the product.

suspend.label: Suspend the licence
suspend.confirmBody: Every user of this site switches to read-only until the licence is reactivated. Changes not yet sent stay on this device.

revoke.label: Revoke the licence
revoke.confirmBody: The licence stops being valid for this site. Only a reactivation by an administrator restores it.

reactivate.label: Reactivate the licence
reactivate.confirmBody: Users get back the operations their licence allows.

compromise.label: Declare the signing key compromised
compromise.confirmBody: The key that signed the current licence is marked compromised and the licence is revoked at once. Use it only if the key leaked.
compromise.noEnvelope: No signed licence is active: there is no signing key to declare compromised.

siteRules.title: Rules per site
siteRules.hint: A planning site may relax a rule for itself only. A site without a rule keeps the strict default. Each change asks for a reason and your identity, and is kept in the history.
siteRules.loadError: The sites could not be loaded
siteRules.noSitesHint: A site is an organisation node whose type can own work (Organisation).
siteRules.historyError: The history could not be loaded

selfApproval.label: Allow self-approval of reliability decisions
selfApproval.help: Off (recommended): a second person approves every reliability decision of this site (four-eyes). Turn on only for a site where one person both proposes and approves; such approvals are labelled "Self-approved".

siteRules.confirmOnBody: The person who proposes a reliability decision at {{site}} will be able to approve it. Other sites keep four-eyes.
siteRules.confirmOffBody: Reliability decisions at {{site}} will again need a second person to approve them.
siteRules.reasonHint: At least {{min}} characters; kept in the history with your name and the time.

errors.SETTING_REASON_REQUIRED: Give the reason for this change (at least 10 characters): it is kept in the history.
errors.SITE_SETTING_STALE: Someone changed this site's rule meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.SITE_SETTING_NOT_A_SITE: This organisation node is not a planning site (its type cannot own work).
